text.text_excerpt: I've only been here a handful of times. I've always had a descent time. Once, I walked in a fashion show here back in December. The ambience and atmosphere is very nice, upscale, and classy. The drinks are very expensive so just be aware of that. There is a separate private room in the back for large and private parties. I'm not sure about the upstairs... I only went up for the fashion show and they closed it off for the models only. So I'm not sure if anyone can go up there at anytime. Nice place, it's worth a shot.

Ahh, I spent many a drunkily drunk dances here! This place is always under constant rennovation. This venue is HUGE. Probably one of largest clubs I've ever been in. there are several rooms with different DJs and there are two levels. There's a stage in the main room as well and several side VIP areas. My friends and I had VIP tickets for our party and were not pleased to find that the general admission line was moving much faster than our VIP line; however once inside, things got better. There were plenty of available seats to sit when my feet began to hurt in my shoes which is a major plus for me lol. I'd visit here again.
